function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the customer's identity using the last 4 digits of their PAN card or their birth year. Must be called before disclosing any debt details.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer (e.g., ACC-88392).

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN suffix or year of birth provided by the customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a Promise-to-Pay (PTP) commitment with the agreed date and amount in the CRM database.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer (e.g., ACC-88392).

ptp_date.description: The agreed payment date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g., 2026-08-14.

amount.description: The amount the customer has agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a secure, direct payment gateway link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer (e.g., ACC-88392).

channel.description: The delivery channel for the payment link.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call to a live human agent or support executive due to dispute, hardship request, or verification failure.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer (e.g., ACC-88392).

reason.description: The reason for escalating the call to a human.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database prior to call termination.

account_id.description: The unique account ID of the customer (e.g., ACC-88392).

notes.description: Detailed notes about the call outcome, customer claims, or agreed payment timeline.
